Overview.Name: Urvi Srivastava
Overview.Goal: Improve appearance, energy, mental wellbeing, and maintain a lean, confident body.

Early_Morning: Option 1: Warm water + plain milk (small cup)
Option 2: Warm water + small bowl curd
Meal_1_Breakfast: Option 1: Paneer bhurji (pan fried) + cooked vegetables
Option 2: Curd bowl + cooked vegetable side
Option 3: Rice rawa upma (small portion) with vegetables
Meal_2_Lunch: Option 1: Plain rice (small portion) + paneer curry + vegetables
Option 2: Plain rice (small portion) + mixed vegetable curry + curd
Option 3: Plain rice (small portion) + dal + cooked vegetables
Meal_3_Dinner: Option 1: Paneer curry + small portion plain rice + vegetables
Option 2: Vegetable curry + small portion plain rice + curd
Option 3: Dal + small portion plain rice + cooked vegetables

Notes_and_Tips: All meals are cooked; no raw salads or boiled-only foods included.
Keep rice portions small to maintain a lean look.
For stress-related sweet cravings, have curd or milk first and pause before eating.
Maintain regular meal timing to support energy and mood.
Simple home-style cooking supports consistency and digestion.
Focus on body feel, confidence, and daily energy rather than scale changes.
